subject: Arantia King Hall of Fame Induction
overview: Student broadcasters produced a variety of segments including an outdoor survival demonstration, sports news, and a promotional skit for a community race. The report highlighted the induction of two-time Olympian Arantia King into the school's Athletes Hall of Fame.

items.title: Leprechaun Scavenger Hunt Skit
items.summary: Students performed a comedic search for a pot of gold around the school building to promote the Leprechaun Race scheduled for March 12th.

items.title: Survival Skills Demonstration
items.summary: Participants discussed techniques for building emergency shelters quickly from wood and moss to conserve energy in cold weather.

items.title: Athletes Hall of Fame Induction
items.summary: Arantia King was inducted into the Athletes Hall of Fame for her career as a world youth champion and two-time Olympic long jumper representing Bermuda.

items.title: Mustang Sports Update
items.summary: Student reporters discussed the Patriots' recent Super Bowl victory, new New Balance athletic jerseys, and high-scoring performances in varsity basketball.
